source_standard: NN/g wireflows (nngroup.com/articles/wireflows) + UML state-machine notation (uml-diagrams.org) for the closed node-type enum NN/g itself leaves unspecified

reference_resolution.rule: every transitions entry must resolve to another state's state_name elsewhere in the same record — graph reference-resolution (issue-515 invariant 2); every flow must contain at least one terminal node_type.

recomputation.rule: a flow is not complete until every state's edge_case_variant is populated — error-state-before-happy-path-only (NN/g's must-be), never asserted complete from happy-path states alone.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a requirements-engineering record landed for a screen/flow-facing requirement AND no interaction-design record exists yet for it
